_readme: W13b provenance manifest (lane-c3, 5 Nov 2026). Sources are named exactly as the rows of wow-ops docs/SOURCES.md. Licence 'mixed' means the file merges several registered sources; the QuestieDB part is redistributed under GPL-3.0-or-later, everything else per SOURCES.md. Keys prefixed 'wowfa:' live in the pvwvuow/wowfa repo. ATT (a builder-named source) is intentionally absent - it is not registered yet; see the doctor 'unregistered-source' row.
